rules.name: Süreç belleğinde yeniden doğrulanmış yerel imza bulgusu

proposed_response.additional_network_or_file_action: not proposed without independently verified target evidence
proposed_response.identity: same PID + kernel starttime jiffies + executable
proposed_response.selection_basis: Detection match does not by itself prove attack intent; propose independent same-target evidence, not severity/name-derived execution.

false_positive_risks: Ham bellek imzaları laboratuvarda doğrulanmalıdır; mevcut yetki, istisna ve yeniden doğrulama kontrolleri zorunludur.
capability_gaps: Live Fedora identity/evidence availability has not been measured.
ACCESS_DENIED/partial/JIT/memfd observations are not clean results or automatic stop authority.
The former RAM-ClamAV scanner is retired; historical records are not live detection or termination authority.

rollback.process: Termination is irreversible; restart/recovery must be planned before authorization.
rollback.network: Existing authenticated unblock workflow; not executed here.
rollback.file: Existing quarantine rollback workflow; protected OS paths remain exempt.
rollback.policy: Restore only this rule’s prior requirement with authenticated operator approval.
